tools.name: app_tracker_keywords
tools.description: Off: always answers source_off. App Store search results and suggestions sit under robots.txt Disallow lines on apps.apple.com, search.itunes.apple.com and itunes.apple.com, so they are not read. Say that search results are not available from an allowed source, and offer app_tracker_charts instead.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: app_tracker_lookup, app_tracker_abandoned, get_feedback_reply · Public sink: app_tracker_keyword_rank, submit_feedback · Destructive: app_tracker_abandoned, submit_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: app_tracker_lookup, app_tracker_abandoned, get_feedback_reply · Public sink: app_tracker_keyword_rank, submit_feedback · Destructive: app_tracker_abandoned, submit_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
